<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="ex87032023-03-0314-24-38" type="excerpt" status="reviewed" part="M" next="ex87032023-03-0314-26-50">
           yang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis dus gsum ma mkhyen pa mi 'thad la | mkhyen na yang 'das ma 'ongs gnyis snang nas mkhyen nam mi snang par mkhyen |  snga ma ltar mi 'thad de 'gags pa dang ma skyes pa snang par mi rung pa'i phyir ro || phyi ma ltar yang mi 'thad de sangs rgyas thams cad mngon sum spyan du mi rung pa'i phyir ro zhe na | 
           <lb n="28b8"/> 'di la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs></note> 'das ma 'ongs gnyis ye shes da ltar ba la mi snang yang da ltar ba'i dngos po snang pa'i shugs la de'i rgyu' dpal dang 'bras bu ma 'ongs pa <abbr>thams cad</abbr> mkhyen pa yin no zhes zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
